en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a monument in a town square. The central feature is a statue of a uniformed soldier holding a raised sword and a flag, standing on a high pedestal surrounded by an ornate wrought-iron fence. Behind the statue is a multi‑story historic building with gabled roof and dormer windows. Large signage on the facade reads "Weisser Adler" and "Dietzelt's Hôtel, Weisser Adler." At street level another sign advertises a hairdresser, "Bernh. Pollack Friseur." There is a dark plaque with German text on the pedestal of the statue.
